scope: Independent source review of the frozen iOS whole-book candidate; no iOS compilation or runtime was possible on this Linux host.
reviewer_lane: frontend_acceptance (Android engine owner; no edits to reviewed iOS files)
review_result: No remaining concrete source blocker found in the reviewed paths. Native memory capability remains 0 until actual hosted compilation and encoded-output acceptance pass.
resolved_findings: Shared Story/memory encoder reservation now stays held until child movies and partial output are removed and decoder/reader/writer references unwind.
ImageIO normalization uses a bounded thumbnail without a framework disk cache, applies EXIF orientation, preserves alpha, and releases resources before reservation release.
Complete request preflight validates scene IDs, counts, total duration, timing, matrix/fit/volume/motion/fades and contiguous book gain windows before child encoders.

Unique still, background and timed-artwork inputs receive byte-level animation rejection plus ImageIO static-image/dimension preflight before any child encoder. Actual two-frame GIF/APNG/WebP assets exercise all four routes.
Only reserved memory child encoding accepts the shared 0.05-second endpoint minimum; ordinary Story minimum stays 0.1 seconds.
Cancellation test now sends an otherwise valid Story request and asserts the exact busy-reservation error, then verifies temp removal and same-ID retry.
Acceptance measures changing-tone source position across a page and gain boundary, slowed original pitch and finite audio coverage, actual EXIF color pixels and transparent/opaque pixels.

acceptance_inventory.runtime_status: Not run locally; inventory and substantive assertions reviewed, not counted as passing encoded-file cases.

local_checks.check: Frozen source digests match the implementing lane's handoff

limits: Hosted simulator encoding and the complete unsigned iOS app compile remain required for these exact sources.
